overview: The Council opened public hearings on a proposed Panera drive-through and the fiscal year 2015 property tax classification, tabling both matters for future meetings. The Council also approved a $200,000 transfer for property revaluation inspections, utility pole placements, signage for Wendy's, and several resolutions concerning public transit, sidewalk accessibility, and student athletics.

items.title: Special Permit for Drive-Through at 499 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Tabled to December 23 at the petitioner's request after initial public testimony due to the medical absence of the applicant's attorney.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2015 Property Tax Classification Hearing
items.summary: Tabled for one week after city assessors presented classification and shift options and the Council requested additional data on certified free cash and cable receipts.

items.title: Fund Transfer for Cyclical Revaluation Program
items.summary: Approved a transfer of $200,000 from overlay surplus to fund the state-mandated cyclical property reinspection program and defend pending Appellate Tax Board cases.

items.title: Pole Relocation on Winthrop Street
items.summary: Approved a joint petition by National Grid and Verizon New England to install and relocate utility poles on Winthrop Street near Burbank Road to serve the American Legion.

items.title: Resolution on Route 96 MBTA Bus Service
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that MBTA Route 96 buses adhere to all scheduled stops at Medford Square and City Hall, amended to request street pavement repairs at a Salem Street bus stop.

items.title: Sign Denial Reversal for Wendy's at 330 Middlesex Avenue
items.summary: Approved sign variances for replacement and new illuminated building signage as part of Wendy's restaurant rebranding and remodeling.

items.title: Resolution on Main Street Sidewalk Accessibility
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Office of Disability inspect National Grid sidewalk excavations along Main Street between Smith and Hicks avenues to ensure ADA compliance.

items.title: Medford High School Athletic Commendations
items.summary: Approved resolutions congratulating girls soccer standout Corey O'Rourke and the league champion girls volleyball and soccer teams, inviting them to receive Council commendations.

items.title: Taxicab Company Compliance Audit
items.summary: Withdrawn by the sponsor to be refiled at a future meeting.

items.title: Discussion of Paid Parking Program Rollout
items.summary: Discussed upcoming Chamber of Commerce informational sessions with Republic Parking regarding the city's meter and kiosk rollout, voting to receive and place the item on file.

items.title: Public Participation on Community Media Access
items.summary: Residents spoke regarding municipal cable franchise fees and the administration's planned announcement of a new community access television station.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting records from November 25, 2014, with clerical corrections, and approved records from December 2, 2014.
